name: ph-saas
description: Atajos del monorepo (reemplaza al Makefile; funciona igual en Windows, macOS y Linux)

scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f api worker beat
scripts.setup: npm run up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U ph_owner -d ph_saas
scripts.samples: docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.make_sample_pdfs
scripts.test:unit: docker compose exec api pytest -q tests/unit
scripts.worker:ping: docker compose exec worker celery -A app.workers.celery_app call system.ping
scripts.lint: docker compose exec api ruff check app tests alembic && docker compose exec api ruff format --check app tests alembic
scripts.mail: echo Bandeja de correo de desarrollo: http://localhost:8025
